import ComponentStates from "../../../../../components/ui/ComponentStates.astro";

The blocking states, each with its primary fix: revoked, expired, version too old, version too new, and channel not entitled. Each state names what happened and what to do, never a raw code.

- **Expired** offers **Renew** and **Use another license**. Renew appears only when your app can renew: otherwise **Use another license** stands alone. It never offers Try again or Reconnect, because neither can change the outcome.
- **Version too new** keeps **Try again** as its one action.

Tell the kit how to renew: SwiftUI draws Renew from the https `url` of `KitOffers` (the live gate has no host renew input yet), Compose `onRenew` on `PolarisGate`, React `renewUrl` or `onRenew` (or `input.renew`), the elements `input.renew` and Qt `renew_url`, and the Godot gate `renew_url` (or a `renew_requested` handler). A URL must be https; Renew then carries the new-window glyph. A handler-only Renew has no glyph.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-python" />

    **Drop-in.** `status` when the gate blocks: the title, the message and the fix as a command.

    **Styled part.** `screens.gate(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `gate_view(status, …)` → `GateView(component="StatusScreen")` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-node" />

    **Drop-in.** `status` (`statusFlow`) when the license is blocked (`revoked`, `expired`,
    `version-too-old`, `version-too-new`, `channel-not-entitled`): the reason and the commands
    that fix it, with exit code 1. The gate check, `checkFlow`, falls through to it.

    **Styled part.** `problemRows` and `fixRows`.

    **Headless.** `statusView(input)`: the StatusScreen state and its `fixes`, each a verb (or null
    for a fix outside the command line) with its copy key; `statusExit(status)` for the exit code.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    <KitStatus kit="swiftui" />

    **Drop-in.** Inside `.polarisKeyGate`: each refusal its own screen with its fix as the only primary (Use a different key, Use another license, Sign out); a fix the kit cannot reach is named, and Try again stays.

    **Styled part.** `StatusScreenView(screen:available:onFix:onTryAgain:)` and `.statusScreenStyle(_:)`.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.statusScreen(_:)`.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** Drawn by `<PolarisKeyGate>` when the license state calls for it, in the chrome of the OS.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<StatusScreen />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("StatusScreen", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Godot">
    <KitStatus kit="godot" />

    <GodotKitTab component="StatusScreen" />

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
